sentences: CYP2D6 normal metabolizer genotypes (*1 and *2 alleles) are associated with increased endoxifen plasma concentrations during tamoxifen treatment in women with operable breast cancer as compared to CYP2D6 intermediate metabolizer genotypes.

CYP2D6 normal metabolizer genotypes (*1 and *2 alleles) are associated with increased endoxifen plasma concentrations during tamoxifen treatment in women with operable breast cancer as compared to CYP2D6 slow metabolizer genotypes.

CYP2D6 intermediate metabolizer genotypes (heterozygous for *10 or *41) are associated with decreased endoxifen plasma concentrations during tamoxifen treatment in women with operable breast cancer as compared to CYP2D6 normal metabolizer genotypes.

CYP2D6 slow metabolizer genotypes (homozygous for *10 or *41 variants or carrying one or more null alleles *3-*6) are associated with decreased endoxifen plasma concentrations during tamoxifen treatment in women with operable breast cancer as compared to CYP2D6 normal metabolizer genotypes.
CYP2D6 genotypes with reduced function are associated with decreased endoxifen plasma concentrations during tamoxifen treatment in women with operable breast cancer.
CYP2D6 genotypes are associated with 4-hydroxytamoxifen concentrations during tamoxifen treatment in women with operable breast cancer.
CYP2D6 genotypes are not associated with tamoxifen concentrations during tamoxifen treatment in women with operable breast cancer.
CYP2D6 genotypes are not associated with N-desmethyltamoxifen concentrations during tamoxifen treatment in women with operable breast cancer.
